about: Every message of Aaron's in the word list walk, a conversation held in his Claude chat on 25 September 2026 - not a session on Terra or Luna. Only his words. Copied character for character from the full export the chat produced (walk/word-list-walk-answers-2.md in this folder). The chat's own log was not available, so this record is only as complete and as exact as that export, and it could not be checked against a log as the other files here were. The earlier Q1-only export (walk/word-list-walk-answers-1.md) agrees with it on every word of his. The times were not recorded: every message carries the date only, and the order is the conversation's. The date is the export's own, his day; the other files here keep UTC, and in UTC the walk may reach into 26 September - the prompt it ran on was saved at 21:40 UTC on the 25th and the rulings taken from it at 01:31 UTC on the 26th. Each quoted block in the export is kept as its own message, as the walk prompt told the chat to give each of his messages as its own block; consecutive messages with no reply between them may be pieces of one spoken message that the dictation or the chat split, and the export does not show which. A message the export quotes more than once (again under the chat's reasoning, asides or studio sections) is kept once, where it falls in the conversation. Eight messages are quoted only in the chat's list of asides; each is placed where the chat's note says it came up, and carries a note saying so. His answers were spoken by voice dictation; the two marked as typed were typed. One passage was withheld at his request: the chat left out the start of one message, which therefore begins with the chat's ellipsis (…), and it records him saying of that passage "But don't include that. That's just for you to understand what I'm thinking." Those words reach us only inside the chat's own note, not as a quotation of his, so they are not kept as a message. Excluded: the prompt that opened the chat (the studio's text, pasted in) and everything the chat wrote - its lines in italics and square brackets, its tables, and its reasoning, open-question, collision, aside and studio summaries.
